name: Pick n Pay
verdict: Pick n Pay is the retail brand of JSE- and A2X-listed Pick n Pay Stores Limited; the Public Investment Corporation, wholly owned by the South African government, is its second-largest shareholder (12%).
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of the Springboks: a four-year Tier 1 contract signed in March 2025 put the gold Pick n Pay logo on the back of the matchday jersey; it appears on the upper back of the 2026/27 home jersey. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposed concern: the Public Investment Corporation (PIC), wholly owned by the South African government, holds 12% of Pick n Pay Stores (pnp-pic-stake) - the company's accounts list the PIC-managed Government Employees Pension Fund block at 15.6% - over the 5% threshold - and South Africa's record is documented (south-africa-marikana-killings). First set to none in the rating sweep before the state-fund stake was known; reset to unrated after the review flagged it (issue #727).
